sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.id,m.arch_type,m.props,a.id,a.props,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.props,'$.archetype.creationDate')) AS SIGNED) AS creation_sort,CASE WHEN m.arch_type='Post' THEN CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.props,'$.archetype.post_id')) AS SIGNED) ELSE CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.props,'$.archetype.comment_id')) AS SIGNED) END AS id_sort FROM anchors hc JOIN anchors m ON m.id=hc.src AND m.kind='NodeAnchor' AND m.arch_type IN('Post','Comment') JOIN anchors a ON a.id=hc.dst AND a.kind='NodeAnchor' AND a.arch_type='Person' WHERE hc.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND hc.arch_type='HasCreator' AND hc.dst IN(?) ORDER BY creation_sort DESC,id_sort DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT e.src,e.dst,n.arch_type,n.props FROM anchors e JOIN anchors n ON n.id=e.dst AND n.kind='NodeAnchor' WHERE e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='ReplyOf' AND e.src IN(?,?) ORDER BY e.seq,e.id
SELECT e.src,e.dst,n.arch_type,n.props FROM anchors e JOIN anchors n ON n.id=e.dst AND n.kind='NodeAnchor' WHERE e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='ReplyOf' AND e.src IN(?) ORDER BY e.seq,e.id

SELECT e.src,p.props FROM anchors e JOIN anchors p ON p.id=e.dst AND p.kind='NodeAnchor' AND p.arch_type='Person' WHERE e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='HasCreator' AND e.src IN(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ORDER BY e.seq,e.id
